Operação Assistida e Confiabilidade: Conduzir operações assistidas em ambientes de missão crítica e atuar proativamente na contenção de falhas e mitigação de riscos sistêmicos. Para se juntar ao nosso time você precisa ter: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Sólida vivência em suporte avançado/sustentação técnica voltada a clientes corporativos (B2B), preferencialmente no setor financeiro, meios de pagamento ou adquirentes. . Domínio em Java e arquitetura de Microsserviços. Conhecimento em banco de dados relacional (MySQL/ PL-SQL), com facilidade para criar, auditar e otimizar queries e scripts complexos sob pressão. Experiência prática em ambientes de nuvem (AWS e/ou Azure). Habilidade com orquestração de contêineres (Kubernetes) e controle de versão (Git). Vivência prática com mensageria (RabbitMQ) e autenticação/segurança (Keycloak). Capacidade analítica destacada para investigação de causa-raiz (root cause analysis). You are the person who gets them unstuck, whether that means fixing a bug, advising on architecture, or sorting out an integration. This is a support role for engineers. You will debug real production issues in customer apps, then take what you learn and fix the underlying platform or AI agent so the same issue never happens again. You will also build automations so your support workflow can scale to hundreds of customers a day. If you are a strong TypeScript and React engineer who likes talking to customers, moves fast, and cares about getting the details right, this role is a strong fit. Why You'll Want to Join You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th) Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy Observance of Holidays per company guidelines 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive This role requires working standard Sydney business hours Work on a modern stack with AI at the core of the product, across multiple cloud providers and AI models Stay in the role as long as you like, with an open path to transition into software engineering, pre-sales engineering, or post-sales engineering after 6 to 12 months What You'll Work On Customer App Resolution Fully resolve issues with customer apps, from fixing bugs to advising on architecture to helping with integrations Work with non-technical customers and explain problems and fixes in clear, simple language Debug production issues using logs, traces, repros, and minimal test cases Close tickets at high volume without sacrificing quality or leaving customers half-helped Product and Platform Improvement Turn every customer fix into a platform improvement by updating the underlying platform or AI agent so the issue does not recur Spot patterns across tickets and flag the product gaps that cause the most customer pain Work with the engineering team to ship fixes quickly and verify they work Knowledge Base and Documentation Keep public and internal documentation up to date, including known issues Write guides and answers that are clear, concise, and tailored to the audience Turn repeated questions into self-serve resources Support Automation Automate your support workflow so you can help hundreds of customers a day Build tooling, scripts, and AI-assisted workflows that cut repetitive work and speed up resolution Continuously improve how support runs rather than just working the queue Incident Response Be the first point of contact for platform incidents during your working hours Manage the public status page and customer communication during incidents Coordinate with engineering on diagnosis and resolution, and follow up with clear updates until it is closed What You Bring Strong TypeScript and React background Solid modern web app fundamentals including HTTP, APIs, authentication, and databases Proven ability to debug production issues using logs, traces, repros, and minimal test cases Strong systems and architecture thinking, including scalability, reliability, performance, and security basics Excellent written communication that is clear, simple, concise, and specific to the audience Prior experience in a customer-facing role such as support, sales, or pre-sales A track record of closing 50 or more tickets a day A bias to ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly Good taste and attention to detail, with pride LLM-based applications Experience building automations or internal tooling to scale a support function Experience managing platform incidents and public status communication Experience supporting non-technical or small business customers How to Apply Please include: Your updated resume A GitHub link or example of work if you have one A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. Location: anywhere in LATAM Please submit your resume in English. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. Responsibilities: Manage large amounts of incoming tickets. Provide support to answer inquiries on products. Accept and handle technical requests. Triage tickets to the other teams. Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies. Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools. Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution. Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents. Take the extra mile to engage customers. Perform other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager. A Bachelor’s degree 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support roles, ideally supporting users of a digital platform. Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce). Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills. Willingness to work on a 4 week rotating shift schedule.. We have multiple shifts through which all team members must rotate. One shift includes weekends (during those 4 weeks), another is a night schedule, another is a morning schedule, etc. A competitive compensation package. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us
